integrity: All reference counts originate in two separately implemented complete exact computations (finite-field arithmetic and affine Groebner unit-ideal testing) whose 312 candidate strings agree. No probabilistic search is used for the asserted exhaustive domain. Self-review is not external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-field statement for the field of three elements and coordinate-fixed pencils; no uniform claim for larger fields, non-rational parameters, or projective-equivalence classes of pencils. Priority against unindexed finite-geometry censuses not independently determined.
title: Sharp smooth blocking-cubic pencil spectrum over \(\mathbf F_3\)
